    Welcome screen

    Start here to create a project or return to work you have already saved. A project keeps your cases, parameter studies, plugins, and report layouts together in one folder.

    Screen controls

    Control What it does
    Create new project Creates an empty project in a new folder.
    Open existing project Opens a project folder or its project.json and resumes it in place.
    Import archived project Imports a .msproject archive into a new folder. Archives contain inputs and layouts; run the imported cases to create results.

    Create or import dialog

    Field or option What it does
    Project name Names the project and its new folder.
    Location Absolute path of the parent folder in which to create the project.
    Project folder Shows the full destination formed from Location and Project name.

    Where your work lives

    Keep working projects in a local folder outside the application installation. Use project archives when transferring inputs between computers. Creating or importing a project requires a new destination folder.

    The Help menu is available before you open a project. It includes the full guides, screen references, search, troubleshooting, About, and licences. About MultiSolid shows the version and a diagnostic summary you can copy. Start with Getting started for the complete first-run workflow, or read Projects and navigation.
